```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
last_season <- 2025L # the 2026 season is still being played
first_class <- 2014L
tier_order <- c("Power", "Group of 5", "FCS and below")
team_season <- tbl(con, "team_season") |>
  filter(season <= last_season, games_played > 0) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(tier_label = factor(tier_label, levels = tier_order))
teams <- tbl(con, "teams") |> collect()
roster <- tbl(con, "roster") |> collect()
picks <- tbl(con, "picks") |>
  filter(year >= first_class, year <= last_season + 1L) |>
  collect()
school_tier <- team_season |>
  filter(!is.na(tier_label)) |>
  transmute(
    collegeTeam = team,
    tier_season = season,
    tier = as.character(tier_label),
    conference
  )
# A credited pick: the player is on a roster before his draft year.
reused <- reused_ids(roster)
traced_ids <- picks |>
  filter(!is.na(playerId), !playerId %in% reused) |>
  inner_join(
    distinct(roster, playerId, season),
    by = "playerId",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  filter(season < year) |>
  distinct(playerId) |>
  pull()
window_picks <- picks |>
  left_join(
    school_tier,
    by = join_by(collegeTeam, closest(year > tier_season))
  ) |>
  mutate(
    traced = playerId %in% traced_ids,
    tier = coalesce(tier, "School not in the data")
  )
# Named players, keyed on athlete id.
wentz <- filter(picks, playerId == "2573079") # Carson Wentz
lance <- filter(picks, playerId == "4383351") # Trey Lance
hill <- filter(picks, playerId == "3116406") # Tyreek Hill
```

```{r}
#| label: compute
small <- filter(window_picks, tier == "FCS and below")
small_traced <- mean(small$traced)
fbs_traced <- mean(window_picks$traced[
  window_picks$tier %in% c("Power", "Group of 5")
])
small_schools <- small |>
  group_by(collegeTeam) |>
  summarise(
    picks = n(),
    traced = sum(traced),
    conference = last(conference),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(picks), collegeTeam)
top_small <- slice_head(small_schools, n = 8)
ndsu <- filter(small, collegeTeam == "North Dakota State")
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
bars <- bind_rows(
  transmute(top_small, collegeTeam, picks, part = "Traced to a roster", n = traced),
  transmute(top_small, collegeTeam, picks, part = "Not on any roster", n = picks - traced)
) |>
  mutate(part = factor(part, levels = c("Not on any roster", "Traced to a roster")))
p <- ggplot(
  bars,
  aes(n, reorder(collegeTeam, picks), fill = part)
) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        collegeTeam, ": ", n, " of ", picks, " picks ", tolower(part)
      ),
      data_id = paste(collegeTeam, part)
    ),
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Traced to a roster" = "#374151", "Not on any roster" = "grey80"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "FCS-and-below draft picks by school",
    subtitle = "Schools with the most picks; dark is traced to a roster",
    x = "Draft picks",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "fcs-school-draft-picks", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
small |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    picks = n(),
    schools = n_distinct(collegeTeam),
    traced = sum(traced),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  transmute(
    `Draft class` = year,
    `Draft picks` = fmt(picks),
    `Schools with a pick` = schools,
    `Traced to a roster` = fmt(traced),
    `Share traced` = pct(traced / picks)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Draft class", "Draft picks", "Schools with a pick", "Traced to a roster", "Share traced"),
    caption = sprintf(
      "Draft picks whose draft-day school played FCS or below in its latest recorded season before the draft, by draft class, and how many the rosters trace to a college roster. Across the window %s of these picks trace, against %s for FBS schools. Tyreek Hill, a round %d pick in %d, came from Division II West Alabama.",
      pct(small_traced, 0),
      pct(fbs_traced, 0),
      hill$round,
      hill$year
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: scatter
p_all <- ggplot(small, aes(year, overall, color = traced)) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        name, ", ", collegeTeam, " (", conference, ")\n",
        year, " draft, round ", round, ", pick ", overall,
        if_else(traced, "\nTraced to a roster", "\nNot on any roster")
      ),
      data_id = paste(year, overall)
    ),
    size = 3.2,
    alpha = 0.85,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, seed = 1)
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(`TRUE` = "#374151", `FALSE` = "#f59e0b"),
    labels = c(`TRUE` = "Traced to a roster", `FALSE` = "Not on any roster"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Draft class",
    y = "Overall pick (earlier picks at the top)",
    title = "Every draft pick from an FCS-and-below school",
    subtitle = "Hover a point for the player, school, and pick",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
card_interactive(p_all)
```
